Specification of Communication Management
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
• the client is subscribed to an event and the actual subscription is re-established
again after being temporarily unavailable (due to restart, network problem or so)
⌋
[SWS_CM_00315] Re-establishing an active subscription
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00103, RS_CM_00104, RS_CM_00106, RS_CM_00107
⌈
The Communication Management shall re-establish the actual subscription again af-
ter the server service being temporarily unavailable (due to restart, network problem or
so). This shall work independently of whether a network binding is involved or not. The
re-establishment shall also provide a possible update of binding specific connection
properties if needed.
⌋
[SWS_CM_00812] Behavior of
ara::com
when unsubscribing from an event
⌈
After calling
Unsubscribe()
by
ara::com
at the proxy side, there shall be no
active subscription to the event and therefore no event shall be delivered to the ap-
plication (i.e. no event receive handler [SWS_CM_10296] shall be called). Calling
Unsubscribe()
shall clear the queue of delivered samples for the event (see chap-
ter 7.5.22.2).
⌋
7.5.14 Receive event
For the event data access C++ API reference, see chapter 8.3.2.2.3.2 and 8.3.2.2.3.1.

Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00202
⌈

GetNewSamples()
